context: Two friends complain about the rainy commute
purpose: Teach: 落ちる/避ける/下がる/決まる/梅雨/渋滞/厳しく/地理

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もう梅雨入りだって。今朝も雨で気分が落ちるよね。
lines.en: It's already the start of the rainy season. The rain this morning made my mood drop.
lines.style: Soft and wistful tone, gently sighing with romantic melancholy

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わかる。バスもひどい渋滞で、店に着くのが厳しくなってきた。
lines.en: I get it. The bus was caught in terrible traffic, so making it to the shop on time is getting tough.
lines.style: Warm but tired barista voice, slightly exasperated yet friendly

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 渋滞を避けるために早く出たのに、結局意味なかった…
lines.en: I left early to avoid the traffic, but in the end it was pointless...
lines.style: Dreamy, drawn-out delivery with a soft sigh at the end

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 気温も下がるし、傘さしても靴がびしょびしょになるし。
lines.en: The temperature drops too, and even with an umbrella my shoes get soaked.
lines.style: Conversational and warm, with a small laugh of resignation

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、今度のお休み、予定もう決まった?どこか行きたいな。
lines.en: Hey, has your next day off been decided? I want to go somewhere.
lines.style: Lilting, hopeful tone shifting to a brighter, flirty register

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まだ決まってないよ。地理に弱いから、近場のカフェ巡りとかでいい?
lines.en: It hasn't been decided yet. I'm bad with geography, so something close like a cafe tour is okay?
lines.style: Cheerful, inviting barista warmth with a gentle laugh

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん。雨の日のカフェって、なんかロマンチックで好き。
lines.en: Of course. Cafes on rainy days have a romantic feel that I love.
lines.style: Soft, swooning delivery with audible smile in the voice

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ行き先も決まるね。梅雨も悪くないかも。
lines.en: Then our destination will be settled too. Maybe the rainy season isn't so bad after all.
lines.style: Bright, kind closing line with cheerful resolve and warmth
